Chat bubble

Source: R/tier1-bubble.R
shad_bubble.Rd

A conversational message surface. Part of the chat/AI kit; usually composed inside shad_message(), but usable on its own.

Usage

shad_bubble(
  ...,
  variant = "default",
  align = c("start", "end"),
  reactions = NULL,
  class = NULL
)

shad_bubble_group(..., align = c("start", "end"), class = NULL)

Arguments

...

Bubble content (text or tags), plus optional named attributes.

variant

One of "default", "secondary", "muted", "tinted", "outline", "ghost" (full-width assistant prose), "destructive".

align

For shad_bubble_group(), the alignment applied to every child bubble: "start" or "end".

reactions

Optional overlapping reaction chips: a character vector (each becomes a chip) or a tag. Give counts/emoji an aria-label.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A bubble tag.

See also

Other shadshiny chat components: shad_attachment(), shad_marker(), shad_message(), shad_message_spinner()

Examples

shad_bubble("How many rows have missing values?", align = "end")
#> <div class="shad-bubble shad-bubble--default shad-bubble--end">
#>   <div class="shad-bubble__content">How many rows have missing values?</div>
#> </div>
shad_bubble("1,284 rows (2.6%).", variant = "muted", align = "start")
#> <div class="shad-bubble shad-bubble--muted shad-bubble--start">
#>   <div class="shad-bubble__content">1,284 rows (2.6%).</div>
#> </div>
